mechanism_taxonomy.curiosity_gap: Creates a specific unanswered question or information gap.
mechanism_taxonomy.hidden_mechanism: Reveals an internal, overlooked, or normally unseen mechanism.
mechanism_taxonomy.stakes: Makes the consequence, cost, danger, limitation, or importance concrete.
mechanism_taxonomy.open_loop: Introduces a question or unresolved thread that is paid off later.
mechanism_taxonomy.progressive_reveal: Releases key information in stages rather than all at once.
mechanism_taxonomy.escalation: Raises complexity, consequence, surprise, or intensity over time.
mechanism_taxonomy.contrast: Uses a clear before/after, normal/extreme, old/new, or A/B contrast.
mechanism_taxonomy.visual_proof: Shows evidence or mechanism visually rather than relying only on narration.
mechanism_taxonomy.specificity: Uses concrete numbers, parts, constraints, examples, or named details.
mechanism_taxonomy.counterintuitive_fact: Leads with or develops a fact that contradicts common expectation.
mechanism_taxonomy.problem_solution: Structures progress around a defined problem and how it is solved.
mechanism_taxonomy.failure_mode: Uses breakdown, failure, limitation, or what-goes-wrong as the organizing device.
mechanism_taxonomy.rules_constraint: Uses rules, regulations, design constraints, or loopholes as narrative pressure.
mechanism_taxonomy.payoff_reveal: Resolves the central promise with a clear reveal, answer, result, or demonstration.
mechanism_taxonomy.identity_emotion: Connects the subject to identity, fandom, mastery, status, nostalgia, or belonging.
